exposure: mechanical methods (insertion of Dilapan) for cervical ripening
outcome: number of days from start of induction to delivery
maternal fever after the third postoperative day
cohort: The study included 85 women with premature rupture of membranes (PROM) at term, singleton pregnancy, cephalic presentation, gestational age of 37-41 weeks, and a Bishop score of 0-2 at the beginning of induction.
finding: The study suggests the potential clinical utility of mechanical cervical ripening methods following PROM at term, noting a 26% cesarean delivery rate, 7% clinical intrauterine infection, and no cases of neonatal infection.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean delivery among women using mechanical cervical ripening methods following PROM at term was 26%.
